name: bf1942-berlin-cq-firedelay-rec
description: Vanilla Berlin Conquest with the server-side recorder, no bots: two sidecar soldiers on the Axis side turn a little every tick, so each one's st row is written on every tick and counts them. The engineer (kit 4) taps ExpPack and Landmine (fireDelay 0.4: 12 ticks in real numbers, 13 in a float32 countdown); the assault soldier (kit 1) throws GrenadeAxis (fireDelay 0.8, 24 either way). The ticks from each press (the upper state's change) to its round (the f row) are the fireDelay timer's count (ledger FA-13, GUN-13; features/fh-fhsw-open-issues/lab-firearms.md).
human: No client: SCRIPT=delay TEAM=1 TURN=1 node lab/firearms_probe.mjs against the server, then `lab.py stop`.
